#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class TaskF {
public:
    int n;
    std::vector<char> s;
    std::vector<int> beauty;

    void solve(int testNumber, std::istream& in, std::ostream& out) {
        in >> n;
        s.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            in >> s[i];
        }
        beauty.resize(n);
        int totalBeauty = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            in >> beauty[i];
            totalBeauty += beauty[i];
        }

        std::vector<int> equalPairs;
        std::vector<int> charCount(128, 0);
        char maxChar = 'a';

        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            if (s[i] == s[n - 1 - i]) {
                equalPairs.push_back(i);
                if (++charCount[s[i]] > charCount[maxChar]) {
                    maxChar = s[i];
                }
            }
        }

        int answer = totalBeauty;
        for (int idx : equalPairs) {
            answer -= std::min(beauty[idx], beauty[n - 1 - idx]);
        }

        if (charCount[maxChar] > (int)equalPairs.size() / 2) {
            std::vector<int> penalties;
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - i] && s[i] != maxChar && s[n - 1 - i] != maxChar) {
                    penalties.push_back(std::min(beauty[i], beauty[n - 1 - i]));
                }
            }
            std::sort(penalties.begin(), penalties.end());
            int rem = 2 * charCount[maxChar] - (int)equalPairs.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < rem; i++) {
                answer -= penalties[i];
            }
        }

        out << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    TaskF task;
    task.solve(1, std::cin, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
